issue.title: mavsdk_server does not clean mission state after flight
issue.body:
If I want to start a second mission after a successful first mission - without restarting mavsdk_server -
the previous state persists.

Resulting in things like: is_mission_finished being true.
This happens even after clear_mission() and reuploading a new mission.

Is there any "cleanup" action I have to do that I am not aware about?

comments.body: Thanks for the issue. That doesn't sound like the correct behaviour. Which PX4 version are you using? And can you reproduce this against SITL?
I am currently experiencing this with a customized PX4 firmware on the Yuneec H520 (in HITL). Will try in SITL with standard firmware now.
I can reproduce it in SITL using PX4 Release 1.10.1
@julianoes, I can confirm the same behavior with 1.11 in the SITL configuration.
@L4ncelot would be great if you could test #1304.
@julianoes #1304 works great, thank you for the support.
